 Srinagar, Nov 8 (PTI) Security forces on Sunday arrested two suspected overground workers of terrorists in Kulgam district of Jammu and Kashmir.
 Muneeb Yaseen Rather and Tahir Bilal were apprehended after they allegedly tried to flee a naka checking at Kulgam town by a joint team of police, the Army and CRPF, officials said.
 They said a pistol and two grenades were recovered from the possession of the duo.
 Show Full Article
 A case under relevant sections of law has been registered at the Kulgam police station, and further investigation has been taken up, the officials added. PTI MIJ PRK
